companion_docs.title: CI that respects a limited Actions budget

ai_context.keywords: scenario exit code, balance band, dirty perf record, version check, CI double run, logics-manager devDependency
ai_context.skip when: fixing a simulation defect (req_035) or the deploy workflow itself (req_038).
ai_context.summary: Three harnesses that already produce the right signal and gate nothing, plus a version drift across three documents that would fail a real deploy.
ai_context.use when: wiring a gate, reading balance or perf evidence, or asking why CI runs twice per push.

docs.title: Make the verification gates able to fail

ai_context.keywords: run-scenarios, offTarget, exit code, target band, ci script, red gate
ai_context.skip when: changing the target band, which item_109 owns deliberately, or adding browser suites to CI.
ai_context.summary: Verified: scenario() returns offTarget and all three call sites discard it, and the file contains no process.exit. Note the blind spot: offTarget only filters waves that were fought, so a run where no wave ever arrives is invisible to it -- which is the actual current failure.
ai_context.use when: wiring the scenario harness or asking why an out-of-band run passes.

docs.title: Let the scenario harness exit non-zero

ai_context.keywords: balance seed, treasury outlier, unbounded spend, homeless drain, marginal lot loop
ai_context.skip when: widening the band to make it pass, or redesigning the economy.
ai_context.summary: Measured live on HEAD, not from the stale record: the band is violated in BOTH directions (wave 1 at the floor, wave 2 over the ceiling), every wave is held, and no seed reaches wave 6. The minus 778k treasury bleed is gone -- that hypothesis died with the stale data.
ai_context.use when: investigating the balance figures or changing economy tuning.

docs.title: Bring the first run back inside its declared band

ai_context.keywords: dirty tree, allow-dirty, perf baseline, union merge driver, append-only record
ai_context.skip when: changing what perf measures, or running it in CI, which has no GPU.
ai_context.summary: The record did not go stale through neglect: the harness was broken. b5af5ca closed the settings menu, #frame-cap went display:none, and perf.mjs timed out on it for 47 commits. Fixed in 418c133. The dirty-tree guard is the remaining half.
ai_context.use when: recording a measurement, or before starting any per-frame cost work.

docs.title: Refuse a performance measurement from a dirty tree

ai_context.keywords: version drift, badge, supported versions, blueprint tag, check-versions script
ai_context.skip when: automating the release bump itself or restructuring the changelog convention.
ai_context.summary: Not cosmetic: the release workflow hard-fails unless the tag matches package.json, so following the blueprint's v0.2.0 produces a failed deploy. SECURITY.md declares the shipping line unsupported.
ai_context.use when: changing the version, or after a release, or reading a document that states one.

docs.title: Fail the gate when a shipped document misstates the version

ai_context.keywords: push trigger, concurrency, devDependency, clean clone, timeout-minutes, Actions budget
ai_context.skip when: SHA-pinning the deploy workflow, which req_038 owns, or adding browser suites.
ai_context.summary: Two identical runs per push on a repo that has a product brief about respecting the Actions budget, and npm run ci -- the documented pre-PR gate -- fails on a clean clone because logics-manager is an undocumented global install.
ai_context.use when: touching .github/workflows/ci.yml or reproducing the gate locally.

docs.title: Run the CI gate once per push, and from a clean clone

ai_context.keywords: placeUtilities false, population zero, total collapse, power, water, scenario blind spot

ai_context.summary: Measured live on HEAD: the no-utilities scenario ends with population ZERO on all six seeds while banking about 34k. Not a harder game -- a total collapse, and one no band filter can see.
ai_context.use when: investigating why a city dies, or what happens when power and water are never built.

docs.title: Stop a city with no utilities dying outright
